target.title: fix(anthropic): reject altered local session cursors
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users paging local Claude session catalog or transcript data could submit altered spellings of an OpenClaw-issued cursor, including appended junk, padding, or extra JSON fields, and have them accepted as the same offset.

## Why This Change Was Made

The local offset decoder now requires both an exact base64url byte round-trip and an exact round-trip through the existing offset encoder. Paired-node cursors remain opaque and are forwarded unchanged. The main risk is rejecting a valid local cursor; canonical catalog and transcript pagination controls cover that boundary.

## User Impact

Local Claude session catalog and transcript pagination now reject altered or non-emitted continuation cursors while valid OpenClaw-issued cursors continue to work.

## Evidence

On `upstream/main` at `ba62b944fa4`, I ran an external harness against the real exported `listLocalClaudeSessionPage()` function with a real temporary home directory on Node v24.18.0:

```text
{"node":"v24.18.0"}
canonical: accepted -> sessions=0
appendedJunk: accepted -> sessions=0
padded: accepted -> sessions=0
extraField: accepted -> sessions=0
```

On this branch, with the same harness and inputs:

```text
{"node":"v24.18.0"}
canonical: accepted -> sessions=0
appendedJunk: rejected -> Error: catalog cursor is invalid
padded: rejected -> Error: catalog cursor is invalid
extraField: rejected -> Error: catalog cursor is invalid
```

Focused validation also covers the same malformed variants for transcript cursors:

```text
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/anthropic/session-catalog.test.ts
Test Files  1 passed (1)
Tests  30 passed (30)

./node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check extensions/anthropic/session-catalog.ts extensions/anthropic/session-catalog.test.ts
All matched files use the correct format.

./node_modules/.bin/oxlint extensions/anthropic/session-catalog.ts extensions/anthropic/session-catalog.test.ts
exit 0

.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode uncommitted
autoreview clean: no accepted/actionable findings reported
overall: patch is correct (0.96)
```

`check-changed` could not run locally because this linked worktree's pnpm dependency check requested a non-interactive `node_modules` reinstall; full checks are left to fork CI.

AI-assisted: Codex helped implement and review the change; the production-function before/after proof and focused validation above were run manually.
